description:
List the distinct values a single ENUMERABLE field actually holds in this account's corpus — so a filter can be built from what is really there instead of from a guess.

Use it when the user names a category, city, or status and you need the exact spelling the data uses ("Restaurant" vs "restaurants"). Optionally pass a prefix to narrow it.

Only fields the catalogue marks enumerable carry values (they have a values_endpoint in list_bulk_corpus_fields). Asking for a free-text field is a 422 that says so — free text has no value list by design, because a DISTINCT over six figures of prose is a table scan per keystroke.

field.description: Catalogue key, e.g. 'business.city'. Must be a key from list_bulk_corpus_fields that carries a values_endpoint.

prefix.description: Optional prefix filter, for narrowing a long value list.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: list_bulk_corpus_values
